ينتصبوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَصِبُوا (yantaṣibū) /jan.ta.sˤi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# يُنْتَصَبُوا (yuntaṣabū) /jun.ta.sˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
